How it works

\n
    \n
  1. 1You feel unsafeAnywhere, any time.
    2. \n
  2. 2Press SOS for 2 secondsThe hold stops accidental alerts.
    3. \n
  3. 3Band takes 3 photosSaves the date and time, with your location from your phone.
    4. \n
  4. 4Sent to the SafeBand appOver Bluetooth to your phone.
    5. \n
  5. 5Alerts reach your peopleFamily and friends, by WhatsApp or SMS.
    6. \n
  6. 6Response team takes actionComing soon.
    7. \n
\n
\n\n\n
\n
\n
\n

An app that tells you the truth

\n

The SafeBand app shows at a glance whether your band is ready, and says so loudly when it is not. No guessing before you need it.

\n
    \n
  • Band status first. Connection, battery and last heartbeat, with a clear warning if the link drops.
    • \n
  • A safety check you can trust. Seven quick checks cover Bluetooth, location, notifications and contacts, each with a fix button.
    • \n
  • See who was reached. Every alert shows which contact received it, and by which channel.
    • \n
  • More ways out. A check-in timer that alerts your contacts if you do not tap \"I'm safe\", and a fake call to leave a situation.
    • \n
\n

SOS is sent only from the physical band, never from a button in the app, so it can't be sent by accident.
